name: MasterSet
description: The explosive growth of AI and machine learning literature -- with venues like NeurIPS and ICLR now accepting thousands of papers annually -- has made comprehensive citation coverage increasingly difficult for researchers. While citation recommendation has been studied for over a decade, existing systems primarily focus on broad relevance rather than identifying the critical set of ``must-cite'' papers: direct experimental baselines, foundational methods, and core dependencies whose omission would misrepresent a contribution's novelty or undermine reproducibility.
